mapper.select: SELECT id, email, nickname, profile, created_at, status FROM member WHERE email = #{email} AND status = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( email, nickname, profile, status ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{nickname}, #{profile}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'Y') )
INSERT INTO social_account ( user_id, provider, provider_id, email, profile ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{provider}, #{providerId}, #{email}, #{profile} )
